title: Module frontend manifest
description: frontend/frontend-manifest.json, beside a module's frontend/bundle.js. The host loads a module frontend only through this file. One rule is not expressible here and is enforced by the validator: hostApi.min <= hostApi.max.

components.description: The component keys the bundle's install() registers, exactly.

hostApi.description: The range of host dependency versions the bundle works with, inclusive.
